item.title: SMD_A&CM_RFQ #518113 - Elevator Rehabilitation and Maintenance for Haber Houses, Coney Island Site 8 and ODwyer Gardens
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-12-16 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking competitive sealed bids, due Dec. 16, 2026, for the rehabilitation, maintenance and servicing of 21 elevators at Haber Houses, O'Dwyer Gardens and Coney Island I Site 8.

The Work under this Contract (RFQ No. 518113 Elevator Package) consists of the rehabilitation, modernization, maintenance, and service of six (6) elevators at Haber Houses, thirteen (13) elevators at O'Dwyer Gardens, and two (2) elevators at Coney Island I Site 8. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and incidental services necessary to complete the Work in accordance with the Contract Documents.

The scope includes, but is not limited to, the removal and replacement of existing elevator systems and the furnishing and installation of new elevator equipment, including machines, controls, hoistway components, car enclosures, doors, communication systems, safety devices, and associated electrical components. The Work also includes testing, inspection, commissioning, training, and coordination with NYCHA and other trades, including separate electrical and abatement packages.

item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-12-22 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking competitive sealed bids, due Dec. 22, 2026, for an indefinite-quantity construction contract covering citywide environmental remediation services such as lead, asbestos and mold abatement.

The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, and incidentals necessary to identify, manage, and remediate environmental hazards including, but not limited to, lead, asbestos, mold, and other hazardous materials in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

Work shall include site assessments and testing; regulatory compliance and permitting; establishment of containment measures; abatement, removal, or encapsulation of hazardous materials; proper handling and disposal of waste; air monitoring and clearance testing; emergency response services; and complete documentation and reporting.

item.title: SMPD_PS_RFP 523229 - The Development and Implementation of Department of Housing and Urban Development Required Training for National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate (NSPIRE) and Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA)
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-10 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority is seeking proposals by Nov. 10, 2026, from firms to develop and deliver training for its property management and central office staff on federal HUD inspection standards (NSPIRE) and the Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA), covering both public housing and housing choice vouchers.

New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) seeks proposals from firms with expertise in National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate (NSPIRE) and Housing Opportunity Through Modernization Act (HOTMA) training (the Proposers) to provide NYCHA with NSPIRE and HOTMA specific training for NYCHAs property management and central office staff, on both the Public Housing side and the Housing Choice Voucher side. This will consist of training sessions (each a Session) and testing materials for the sessions.  The topics for NSPIRE included in the Sessions must be customized to ensure NYCHAs staff is able to (a) comply with the rules and regulations set forth in HUDs NSPIRE program (b) conduct visual  inspections of Public Housing Developments in accordance with HUDs Uniform Physical Condition Standards (UPCS), and (c) identify and repair deficiencies found pre, during, and post NSPIRE inspections in accordance with industry standards. item.title: New York City Housing Authority Board Meeting
item.description:
Housing Authority | Public Hearings and Meetings | Meeting | Hearing: 2026-10-20 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Housing Authority will hold its next public Board Meeting on Tuesday, Oct. 20, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. at 90 Church Street in Manhattan, with live streaming on its YouTube channel and website.

The next Board Meeting of the New York City Housing Authority is scheduled for Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. in the Ceremonial Room on the 5th Floor of 90 Church Street, New York, New York 10007 (unless otherwise noted). This Board Meeting will also be streamed live on NYCHA's YouTube Channel at https://www.youtube.com/c/nycha and NYCHA's Website at https://www.nyc.gov/site/nycha/about/board-meetings.page

These Board Meetings are open to the public. To provide comment in-person, all speakers are required to pre-register, at least forty-five (45) minutes before the scheduled Board Meeting. Comments are limited to the items on the Calendar. Speaking time will be limited to three (3) minutes. The public comment period will conclude upon all speakers being heard or at the expiration of thirty (30) minutes allotted for public comment, whichever occurs first. Comments may also be provided to the Office of the Corporate Secretary by e-mail at corporate.secretary@nycha.nyc.gov or by mail at 90 Church Street, 5th Floor, New York NY 10007.
